enrich_contact.description: Enrich a single contact with Dropcontact: find and verify the professional email and phone number, and fill in name, job title, company, website, and LinkedIn from whatever details you provide. Give at least one identifying detail (an email, a full name, a first and last name, a company, or a website).
enrich_contact.name: enrich_contact

parameters.description: Known email address of the contact. Dropcontact will verify it and use it to match the person.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Full name of the contact. Use this instead of first and last name when you only have the name as one string.
parameters.name: full_name

parameters.description: Website or domain of the contact's company (e.g. dropcontact.com). Improves match accuracy.
parameters.name: website

parameters.description: Known phone number of the contact
parameters.name: phone

parameters.description: URL of the contact's LinkedIn profile
parameters.name: linkedin

parameters.description: French SIREN/SIRET company registration number, used to pin the enrichment to a specific French company.
parameters.name: num_siren

parameters.description: Set to true to also return legal company data for French companies (SIREN, VAT number, headcount, NAF code). This uses more Dropcontact credits per contact.
parameters.name: siren

parameters.description: Language used to normalize the returned civility and job title.
parameters.name: language

credits_left.description: Enrichment credits remaining on the account

data.description: Raw Dropcontact data array (one entry per contact)

request_id.description: Dropcontact request id for this enrichment

description: Enrich B2B contacts with Dropcontact: find and verify professional emails and phone numbers, and complete names, job titles, and company details.
